sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chains to multi-agent systems that can plan, use tools, and iterate autonomously. Highlighted real production use cases and infrastructure challenges around reliability and observability.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on building reliable AI tooling infrastructure, emphasizing the importance of local-first developer tools and avoiding vendor lock-in. Covered practical automation patterns for developers working with LLMs.

sources.author: Emmanuel Ameisen
sources.headline: Head of AI @ Anthropic (formerly Stripe)
sources.post_summary: Posted about the current state of AI agent reliability in production environments, noting that most agent failures stem from poor tool design rather than model intelligence. Shared frameworks for evaluating agent performance.

sources.author: Santiago Valdarrama
sources.headline: ML Engineer & Technical Content Creator
sources.post_summary: Broke down the infrastructure stack needed to run AI agents at scale, covering orchestration, memory management, and cost optimization. Compared open-source frameworks versus managed platforms for developer teams.

sources.author: Aakash Gupta
sources.headline: Product Growth @ Ramp | Newsletter: Product Growth
sources.post_summary: Discussed how modern GTM engineering teams are replacing traditional SDR motions with automated outbound sequences that leverage intent data and AI personalization at scale. Shared metrics showing 3x reply rate improvements when combining Clay + GPT workflows.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Ex- Amplitude, Dropbox, SurveyMonkey
sources.post_summary: Explained how revenue operations teams should structure content strategy around buyer journey stages rather than product features. Highlighted a framework that increased pipeline velocity by 22% through targeted content at each funnel stage.

sources.author: Scott Barker
sources.headline: Founder @ SellMeThisPen | GTM @ Webflow
sources.post_summary: Shared a case study on building an outbound automation engine using Apollo + Zapier + custom scoring models. Detailed how his team reduced cost-per-meeting by 40% while maintaining reply quality through iterative A/B testing of sequences.

sources.author: Utkarsh Gupta
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Vanta | Ex- Stripe
sources.post_summary: Broke down the technical architecture behind modern revenue operations stacks, focusing on data orchestration between CRM, enrichment tools, and engagement platforms. Emphasized the shift from manual processes to engineered, measurable systems.

sources.author: Daniel Murray
sources.headline: Head of Growth @ Reprise | GTM Advisor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed how content strategy and outbound automation should be synchronized rather than siloed. Provided examples of using customer interviews to generate both high-converting LinkedIn content and personalized cold email sequences.

sources.author: Daniel Vassallo
sources.headline: Independent maker & former AWS engineer
sources.post_summary: Shared how he built and launched a simple SaaS product solo in under 3 weeks using no-code tools and Stripe. Emphasized shipping fast over perfection and how he validated demand with a landing page before writing code.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List & Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Posted about shipping a new micro-SaaS in a weekend using AI tools. Detailed his process of building in public, sharing revenue numbers, and iterating based on user feedback from Twitter and LinkedIn.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | Ex-Google, Stripe
sources.post_summary: Wrote about her transition from big tech PM to solo founder. Shared lessons from building her first product alone, including how she handles marketing, support, and code without a team.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author of Zero to Sold | Indie founder
sources.post_summary: Discussed his journey pivoting from corporate software engineering to bootstrapped founder. Highlighted the mindset shift required when shipping products publicly and learning marketing as a developer.

sources.author: Justin Jackson
sources.headline: Founder @ Transistor.fm | Maker
sources.post_summary: Shared weekly updates on building and launching new features for his solo SaaS. Talked about the value of consistent public progress updates and how it helped him get early customers and feedback.
